content: expo-print SDK 57: On iOS printing from HTML does not support local asset URLs due to WKWebView limitations - docs say use inlined base64-encoded strings; images need to be converted to base64 and inlined into the HTML. printToFileAsync returns uri/numberOfPages and optional base64 (no data: prefix). Android-only: textZoom, @page margin styling; iOS-only: printerUrl, orientation, margins, useMarkupFormatter - useMarkupFormatter swaps to UIMarkupTextPrintFormatter which does not display images and can add blank last page unless HTML is well-formed with DOCTYPE. iOS printAsync rejects if print window closed; Android resolves immediately.
